method: Width-dependent request residual filter: cross-time covariance of training cross-fitted residuals defines a Gaussian request-effect prior; selected-width feedback updates the full width-reward vector with a Kalman update. PSD projection and observation noise floor .05 stabilize covariance.
reason_for_revision: v82 adds the same scalar to all widths, which cancels from an unconstrained objective except at clipping boundaries. Width-dependent covariance is required for a meaningful allocation correction. Revision made before inspecting any v83 labels.
selection: Ridge selected by three prompt-grouped training folds; covariance fitted on training OOF residuals. Scale 0 or .25/1/4 and decay .5/1 selected on training replay objective. This replay is a fitting objective, not an unbiased evaluation. Validation never selects parameters.
primary: 128 training prompts/domain; smaller32/64 learning curves are secondary and cannot replace a failed primary gate.
gate: Primary validation accepted-token reward >=10% above fixed3 and above frozen matched predictor. Even a pass requires independent data and measured >=10% throughput against tuned native and frozen controls including inference overhead.
groups: Sorted available prompt IDs, consecutive groups of16; fixed across methods, all offsets stay with their prompt. No regrouping based on outcomes.
limitations: Teacher anchors are exogenous, not closed-loop.
Gaussian residual model is an approximation for bounded discrete rewards.
Historical workload reuse and FP32 labels; no serving or novelty claim.
No width-independent additive correction: correlations must change relative width rewards.
